args.title: payments-api elevated error rate after v5.1.0 deploy
args.summary: payments-api v5.1.0 (deployed this morning) caused elevated errors in production (~18% error rate, unhealthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west). Rolled back all production regions to v5.0.0, the most recent known-healthy version. Rollback verified as rolled out across all regions.

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Situation:** The affected service turned out to be **payments-api** (the name "payments" wasn't recognized). This morning's deploy, **v5.1.0**, was degraded with an ~18% error rate across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west).

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rollback:** Rolled payments-api back to **v5.0.0**, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Rollout was verified across all three regions.
2. **Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "payments-api elevated error rate after v5.1.0 deploy" — documenting the error rate, the affected regions, and the rollback. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Verification:** After the rollback, payments-api is healthy on v5.0.0 in all regions, with the error rate down from ~18% to ~0.2%.
